Led by TU Dublin, Ireland’s largest technological university, the Hub is positioned as a national resource to help researchers transform their work into impactful solutions. The position of the Hub within the Irish publicly funded ICT research ecosystem is to play a bridging role between ICT research supported by Research Ireland Research Centres (RCs) and Centres for Research Training (CRTs) and the next stage of entrepreneurial or commercial activity. This is particularly timely, as a large number of PhD graduates are now emerging from these programmes, generating a surge in ICT research outputs ready for translation. The Hub will support both centre-affiliated and independent researchers across Ireland, thanks to its collaborative structure with multiple universities, technological universities, and partner organisations. It acts as a pre-commercialisation platform, enabling researchers to build skills, secure funding, and develop prototypes before moving on to full-scale entrepreneurial ventures.
